title: Checkout stress monitor
proposal: We want to install webcams at every checkout that read cashiers' facial expressions and flag stress or frustration to the shift manager in real time. We will use an off-the-shelf vendor tool. The goal is to rotate tired staff earlier and improve customer service.

title: Consumer loan scoring
proposal: We are building an in-house model that scores each applicant's creditworthiness from their transaction history and income, and automatically approves or declines consumer loans under 20,000 euros. Larger loans go to an analyst.

title: Card fraud alerts
proposal: We will use a vendor system that flags suspicious transactions on customer cards for fraud review. Flagged payments are held until an analyst checks them.

title: CV shortlisting assistant
proposal: We are building a tool that reads CVs, scores each candidate against the job description and shortlists the top 20 applicants for recruiters. Recruiters only see the shortlist.

title: Warehouse shift planner
proposal: We will use a vendor tool that tracks pickers' productivity scores and behaviour data and allocates tasks and shifts each morning. The vendor says the tool only prepares a recommendation and the final decision remains with the supervisor.

title: Online exam proctoring
proposal: We want to deploy an AI proctoring service that watches webcam footage during online exams and flags students it suspects of cheating for the exam board.

title: Resident reliability score
proposal: The council plans a resident reliability score built from fines, unpaid taxes and complaints, used to decide who gets priority for municipal sports facilities and housing subsidies.

title: Life insurance pricing
proposal: We are building an in-house model that sets premiums for individual life insurance from the medical questionnaire and lifestyle answers. Standard cases are accepted automatically with no human review.

title: Customer service chatbot
proposal: We will deploy a chatbot on our website that answers billing questions and helps customers change their tariff. It is built on a vendor's general-purpose model.

title: Ad creative generator
proposal: We are building an in-house tool that generates images and short videos for our clients' social media ads from a text brief.

title: Stock forecasting
proposal: We want to forecast weekly demand for each furniture model from past sales and seasonality, to set reorder quantities for our warehouse. No personal data is used.

title: Face search database
proposal: Our startup will scrape public photos from social networks to build a searchable database of faces, so that clients can upload a photo and find a person's profiles.

title: Emergency call triage
proposal: We will use a vendor model that listens to 112 emergency calls, estimates urgency and recommends which ambulance to dispatch, which the operator confirms.

title: Talking doll with in-app store
proposal: We are building a talking doll that chats with children and uses persuasive prompts to nudge kids towards in-app purchases of new outfits.

title: Pipe pressure control
proposal: We are building an AI model that controls pressure valves and automatic shut-off in the municipal water network to prevent bursts. It acts as a safety function.

title: CEO video avatar
proposal: We will use a vendor tool to create a deepfake video avatar of our CEO that presents quarterly results to employees.
